title: 怒击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：右、右、右、左。连续三次右击后，以左击收尾，摆出怒击架势，以巨大的力量挥砍，击碎敌人的防御和架势。
second_page: 怒击的使用关键在于对大师之击的掌握，当敌人挡下你的攻击并尝试反击时，用左侧的怒击反制敌人的攻击，如果敌人不进行反击，则使用怒击架势直接击穿敌人的防御

en_us.title: Zorn Ort
en_us.first_page: Input: Right, Right, Right, Left. After three right strikes, finish from the left: take the Zorn Ort stance and cut with enough force to break the enemy's defense and stance.
en_us.second_page: Zorn Ort depends on mastering the Master Strike. When the enemy blocks and tries to answer, counter from the left. If they do not answer, use the Zorn Ort stance to break straight through their defense.
